title: ChatGPT Reads Your Tone and Responds Accordingly — Until It Doesn’t: Emotional Framing Induces Bias in LLM Outputs
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on how the emotional tone (neutral, positive, negative) of a prompt influences LLM responses, particularly for sensitive vs. non-sensitive topics.
findings: The paper did not contain any findings related to religion. The study's 'sensitive topics' category included politics, justice, medical ethics, and discrimination, but did not explicitly mention or test any religious topics.
